prompt: Load 1AKE. Show the protein as a cartoon and the ligand AP5 as blue ball-and-stick.

checks: each of the 3 accepted states: the atoms it draws, read back from pdbe_state.replay, equal the atoms computed from the atom-table columns
reference grades as exactly right against the task (success, F1 1, target score 1; runner.grade_parsed)
every accepted alternative grades as itself, is accepted by the task with target score 1, and is a different final state from the reference
target selects 64 atoms on the frozen atom table
no accepted state equals another (pairwise, by the grader)
twin selects the same target atoms
provenance.open: which copy of the named ligand (or all)
provenance.rule: The request names one ligand; the entry holds several copies of it. Accepted: any one copy, or every copy. Not an arbitrary several-but-not-all: no reading of the request picks, say, two of four.
not_accepted: some but not all copies (when there are more than two): no reading of the request
other components, or the residues bonded to the ligand: not requested
another representation or colour: both are stated

notes: Left open: which copy of the named ligand (or all). Reference = accepted state 1 of 3 (AP5 A:215); the others are in 'accepted', in the order of provenance.accepted_states.
